recentItems.title: How these Bangsamoro women pivoted from batallion to civilian life (Full Documentary) | ABS-CBN News
recentItems.description:
Presented by ABS-CBN News Documentaries, “Hindi Suntok sa Buwan ang Kapayapaan" (Peace is Not a Moonshot) tells the story of the long journey toward the establishment of the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM).

The documentary, narrated by award-winning Kapamilya actress Jodi Sta. Maria, follows the personal stories of three women whose pasts were tied to the Bangsamoro Islamic Women Auxiliary Brigade (BIWAB) and Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF). The story follows their transition into civilian life following the 2014 peace deal between government and MILF leaders. The story delves into the women’s transition to quiet, civilian lives. 

Produced by ABS-CBN News’ senior producer Dianne RJ Obdin, the documentary also traces pivotal moments in the Bangsamoro peace process, highlighting the real effort it takes to turn the hope of peace into reality.Subscribe to the ABS-CBN News channel! - https://www.youtube.com/@abscbnnews

recentItems.title: Remulla says Romualdez 'now considered a person deprived of liberty' at Cardinal Santos
recentItems.description:
MANILA — DILG Sec. Jonvic Remulla said on Monday evening that ex-House speaker Martin Romualdez will temporarily remain in Cardinal Santos Medical Center after being confined due to "a cardiovascular event, unstable blood pressure, and anxiety attacks."

This was after they served the arrest warrant issued by the third district of the Sandiganbayan.

Remulla added that armed police will remain in and out of the hospital to secure Romualdez and that the DILG and PNP will return every day to verify if Romualdez is already fit enough to be transferred to the Payatas City Jail.

"Dadalhin namin siya sa Payatas sa tamang panahon 'pag sinabi ng doktor na kaya na niya. Hindi ito permanent situation. Ang kuwarto niya sa Payatas ay naghihintay na," he said.
